headline: Seconds constraints, alt takes, and a bar that stops wrapping
highlights: Nine new time constraints speak in seconds instead of percent: TC +1/2/3s (the target may run that much longer than the source, never shorter), TC −1/2/3s (that much shorter, never longer), and TC ±1/2/3s (either way). Mapping labels like “TC+2”, “-1s” or “+/-3” resolve on import, and violations are stated in seconds — the unit the constraint is written in.

A target named with the _LBALT suffix is recognised as an alternative take: paired against the untagged line’s source automatically, checked against that line’s constraint, and badged in the list. Takes that arrive without the tag can be marked by hand — Set time constraint → Mark as Alt Take — and the mark survives re-imports and saves with the project.
